OPERATING_EVIDENCE.description: Direct evidence that the control operated, was reviewed, validated, executed, retained, or enforced.

DECISIONAL.description: Approved decisions, adjudications, exceptions, or scope/policy approvals that may support but do not independently prove operating effectiveness.

DEFINITIONAL.description: Control definitions, schemas, taxonomies, policies, catalogs, and configuration that define expectations but do not prove operation.

PRIOR_COMPLIANCE_RESULT.description: Prior compliance outputs or derived status reports. These cannot be primary evidence for reevaluating the same control.

GENERATED_PROPOSAL.description: Proposed or synthesized evidence records generated by discovery tooling.
